svg.text: A good architecture supports use cases and operation, maintenance, development and deployment; it makes the system easy to change in all the ways it must change by
Horizontal layers change for different reasons (UI versus business rules; application-specific rules such as input validation versus domain rules such as interest or
inventory counts; database, query language and schema) and vertical use case slices change for different reasons (add versus delete an order): decouple both ways,
keeping use cases visible. Then new use cases do not disturb old ones, and teams (feature, component or layer) do not interfere.
